sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (26/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is mixed and stale (107+ days old) with no clear conviction signal.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (367.36) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 68 days adds moderate event risk; macro score of -1 confirms unfavourable conditions for MMM.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold conditions (RSI 9, Stochastic, Williams %R) combined with 15x volume spike and fear-zone sentiment create capitulation setup with support at 109.88 offering defined risk for contrarian bounce.
debate.key_bear_argument: Complete absence of bullish confirmation—price below all moving averages (9/21/50/200), negative MACD histogram, bearish three-black-crows pattern, negative CMF distribution, and VIX crisis regime (367.36) indicate structural weakness that oversold technicals cannot overcome without reversal confirmation.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme oversold technicals (RSI 9, Stochastic, Williams %R) with 15x volume capitulation signal present a contrarian setup; however, complete absence of bullish confirmation (price below all MAs, negative MACD, bearish pattern, negative CMF) and VIX crisis regime (367.36) eliminate high-probability entry conditions.
decision.primary_risk: Macro environment remains unfavourable with VIX in crisis mode; structural bearish setup (all MAs bearish, three-black-crows, negative CMF) suggests oversold bounce may fail without reversal confirmation, risking further downside below 109.88 support.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technicals show extreme oversold (bullish) but fundamentals, sentiment, and risk all confirm structural weakness (bearish); debate winner is bear with high confidence.
